headlines.title: Senate Judiciary Committee advances Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination
headlines.description: Republicans on the Senate Judiciary Committee voted to advance acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve in the role permanently. NBC News' Scott Wong and Gabe Gutierrez have details on what senators had to say in support or opposition of the nomination and when it will face a full Senate vote.

headlines.title: Democrats Face Big Test in Critical Michigan Primary
headlines.description: It is primary day in a handful of states and voters are heading to the polls with key races up for grabs that could signal which direction the parties are headed before the November midterms. One of the most closely watched contests is taking place in Michigan, which has become the Democrat’s most expensive Senate primary race ever. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports and Steve Kornacki joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: West Coast Wildfires Rage on as Arson Suspect Arrested
headlines.description: Police have announced the arrest of a man on suspicion of arson, connected to one of the wildfires burning out of control in Washington state. As dozens of fires burn across the West, conditions spawned a rare “firenado,” a twister of flames caught on video. NBC’s Morgan Chesky reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the latest forecast.

headlines.title: Embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller requests an Ethics investigation into himself
headlines.description: Rep. Max Miller, R-Ohio, will request the House Ethics Committee to investigate domestic abuse allegations made by his ex-wife to try to exonerate himself.

headlines.title: Russia says a Ukrainian drone struck a busy beach, killing at least 7 people
headlines.description: Russia said that seven people, including three children, had been killed and about 40 injured in what it said was a deliberate Ukrainian drone attack on civilians.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: ‘Game of Thrones’ author George R. R. Martin opens up about experiencing depression
headlines.description: George R. R. Martin, author of the wildly popular “Game of Thrones” book series, shared that he’s pulled back from updating fans via his blog as he “battled sadness and depression.”

headlines.title: Embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller requests an Ethics investigation into himself
headlines.description: Rep. Max Miller, R-Ohio, will request the House Ethics Committee to investigate domestic abuse allegations made by his ex-wife to try to exonerate himself.

headlines.title: UFC fighter Allan Nascimento dies at 34 after apparent heart attack in his sleep
headlines.description: Brazilian MMA fighter Allan Nascimento died Monday after suffering a heart attack as he slept, the UFC said.

headlines.title: Video shows moment drone burst into fireball on Russian beach
headlines.description: Russia and Ukraine traded blame after a drone slammed into a beach in the Black Sea resort town of Gelendzhik. Russian officials said seven people were killed.

headlines.title: Trump claims Iran talks are underway as Tehran denies it
headlines.description: President Donald Trump accused Iran of duplicity and insisted the two sides were discussing reopening the Strait of Hormuz as early as Tuesday, even as Tehran denied talks were even taking place.

headlines.title: East Asia is baking in ‘cruelly hot’ summer
headlines.description: A deadly heat wave is gripping large parts of East Asia, bringing the hottest temperature on record in South Korea and complicating earthquake recovery efforts in Japan.
